selection.fallback: Disable artifact tiers and compile normally when the ABI, symbols, or supported version are unavailable.

zstd.runtime_dispatch: BMI2 on generic GCC/Clang x86 builds
zstd.compile_time_acceleration: x86-64 SSE2 baseline; AArch64 NEON; general AVX2 only when enabled in CFLAGS
zstd.assembly: x86-64 Huffman decompression assembly enabled; no_asm is disabled
zstd.no_asm_result: Exclusive pair: 860.6 versus 798.9 MiB/s aggregate decompression with identical output and compression throughput.
zstd.lto: fat-lto failed with GCC/rust-lld; fat-lto/thin-lto require coordinated Clang/LLVM plugin LTO and are not portable defaults.
zstd.thin: Size-minification mode; disables dynamic BMI2 and forces smaller decoders.
zstd.pkg_config: Requests static linkage; no libzstd.a is installed by the Fedora development package on this host.

structured_zstd.implementation: Stable std::arch target_feature kernels; no nightly portable_simd.
structured_zstd.dispatch: std runtime decode dispatch; no_std compile-time target_feature selection.
structured_zstd.encoder_acceleration: Independent runtime BMI2 Huffman writer on x86 and SVE2-tagged histogram path on AArch64; kernel feature removal is decode-scalar, not wholly scalar.

zrip.implementation: Stable fearless_simd target-feature dispatch in decode sequence execution only; encoder has no explicit SIMD.
zrip.nightly: Not enabled; it controls optimization attributes, not SIMD availability.

lz4_flex.implementation: No runtime SIMD dispatcher; compile-time AVX can affect a small copy primitive.
lz4_flex.unsafe_reference: Disabling safe/checking paths measured 715.5/1625.0 versus 604.7/1407.7 MiB/s aggregate, but is not suitable for persistent records.
